name: SkyEye Connector
description: Production SkyEye package backed by the existing SkyEye device tools. It syncs security alarms and honeypot-source alarms into Flocks alerts and honeypot events.

release.notes: Adds read-only SkyEye alarm and honeypot event sync through the device tool registry.
changelog: Uses SkyEye alarm list for general alert ingestion.
Uses data_source=7 to ingest honeypot-originated events.
Keeps device targeting configurable through FLOCKS_CONNECTOR_DEVICE_ID.
